content.text: {"notes":["All requested readouts are at absolute time t=1.0 s; joint angles are unwrapped and expressed in radians, and angular velocities in rad/s.","Joint quantities use each joint's local frame, while the tip position is a world-frame vector in meters under the right-handed x-forward, y-left, z-up convention.","Both joints receive a constant 0.9680998863 N·m torque; joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m during the scheduled interval [0.4378, 0.5378) s.","joint_limit_by_T indicates whether either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the requested time; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
